consolidated.name: STRIDE — Space-Time Risk-priced, Inertia-routed Dynamic-Escape planner (merges STRAID + TRIAGE + TARIFF)
consolidated.one_liner: A total-function global planner: one Lagrangian risk-price λ sweeps the main-line conformal collision budget (Σα_i ≤ ε_pred; human∈label-set = un-deflatable hard) across detected agents on a risk-weighted space-time (station,time) RCSP DAG, and the SAME price selects the space-time passing-order (winding/"braid") class — its breakpoints ARE the pass-front-vs-behind switches — yielding a native (makespan, certified-risk) Pareto frontier whose λ→∞ endpoint is the certified recovery class, so the map world→(trajectory, certified-risk∈[0,1]) is total and never returns ⊥. An O(M) reduced-Hessian inertia (independent LDLᵀ) routes leaf stalls into {flip-winding / escape-saddle / re-time / yield}, and a quintic-Bernstein per-segment certificate makes the risk bound continuous-time. Crucially safety is DECOUPLED from winding-enumeration completeness (winding only picks WHICH local min; it is provably outside the safety bound) — the honest repair of the static-homotopy/A1 blind spot. The planner's min-risk scalar IS the safety layer's P(hit)≤ε number.
genuinely_new_residual: Conformal QUANTILE as a tradeable dual resource welded to the main-line ε-certificate (from TARIFF): α_i indexes the distribution-free calibrated tube radius r_i=Q_{1-α_i} (NOT a Gaussian chance-constraint probability mass à la IRA), so λ has units 'makespan per unit conformal quantile' and the planner objective IS the certificate. Strip the parts (RCSP/Lagrangian dual, IRA allocation, conformal tubes) and each is classic; new = wiring conformal calibration into RCSP resource pricing ON the main-line P(hit) decomposition.

The price IS the topology selector and its breakpoints are certified (merge of TARIFF+STRAID): one λ simultaneously (a) reallocates per-agent budget and (b) selects the space-time winding class; the λ-continuation breakpoints λ_k ARE the pass-front-vs-behind switches, so a (time,certified-risk) Pareto STAIRCASE is the planner's native output, not a single trajectory. Budget reallocation and topology flip are one mechanism, not two.

Safety/optimality DECOUPLED from winding-enumeration completeness — the A1 neutralizer (TRIAGE): the executed trajectory's risk certificate is computed post-hoc on the chosen quintic path via conformal tube + Bernstein hull at trajectory-local time, INDEPENDENT of how many winding classes were enumerated; incomplete enumeration costs only the anytime gap, never safety.

Min-risk TOTAL-FUNCTION semantics anchored at a certified recovery class (STRAID+TRIAGE+TARIFF): codomain always (trajectory, ρ); 'stuck' redefined as the finite scalar min-risk>ε (NOT a solver flag), at which the λ→∞ recovery class (max-min-clearance yield + spec-§3 z-climb-to-invariant-set) is returned with its bound. Existence constructive (recovery candidate set contains 'stay' ⇒ never empty).

O(M) reduced-Hessian inertia λ_min promoted to a CROSS-LAYER stall-type router (TRIAGE generalization of M6 — the search's 'only lever both new AND rigorous'): the same independent symmetric-indefinite LDLᵀ that gives the leaf its second-order step yields the inertia that classifies {numerical-saddle / topologically-trapped-in-this-winding / dynamically-infeasible} and dispatches {escape / flip-class / re-time}. Distinct from IPOPT/SQP inertia CORRECTION (they add δI to regularize; we READ the spectrum to arbitrate the branch).

(honest, weaker) The space-time winding index is BUILT from existing primitives (heat-A* lateral sides × ST-graph pass-order DP), giving a dynamic-domain topology index with NO new GVD/Yen/H-signature/braid combinatorial engine — pragmatic but bounded-K, not complete.
collision_targets: arXiv 2511.18170 (conformal × space-time tube) — #1 closest on the conformal×spacetime axis; must show conformal-QUANTILE-as-tradeable-dual-resource + winding-class coupling, not just a probabilistic tube.

T-MPC++ (de Groot et al. 2024, T-RO) — most dangerous; topology-guided PARALLEL MPC in the dynamic pedestrian domain. Must show (a) winding as a certified space-time invariant vs their parallel-topology heuristic, (b) tradeable conformal risk budget + dual price, (c) inertia router + total function — none of which T-MPC++ has.

IRA (Ono–Williams iterative risk allocation) + dual RCSP (arXiv 2302.13115) — risk-budget-as-resource prior; show conformal-quantile (non-Gaussian) resource + winding coupling + anytime, not chance-constraint allocation along a fixed homotopy.

Mavrogiannis & Knepper space-time braids / topological-braids robotics line — the braid/winding PRIMITIVE is theirs, MUST cite. Delta: single ego vs NON-reactive pedestrians = winding-vector (relative-homotopy), NOT a full Artin braid; ours carries a conformal budget + dual price + total function in a single-ego setting.
EGO-Planner-v2 / Bubble Planner / TRUST-Planner — the D1 'this is just EGO-v2' attack; show the global certified layer ABOVE the leaf.

ST-GCS (2503.00583) / GCS* (2407.08848) / INSATxGCS (2410.08909) / ST-RRT* (2203.02176) — space-time / global-optimality planners; bites ONLY if the continuum lower-bound is claimed (the demoted weakest link). Contrast price-driven winding + tradeable risk vs convex-restriction global search.
Trautman–Krause (freezing robot / IGP) — the 'never frozen' motivation; position totality (existence + bounded-risk) AGAINST the freezing-robot impossibility (do NOT claim goal-liveness).
IPOPT/SQP inertia-controlling factorizations (Wächter–Biegler) — distinguish inertia-as-ROUTER from inertia-as-REGULARIZER on the full KKT.
Pearlmutter Hvp / Gauss-Newton / Bunch-Kaufman LDLᵀ — classic second-order components; cite as 'combined,' quantify D2 (var count 4M−3, per-step flops) vs iLQR/DDP.
consolidated.dynamic_soundness: SOUND in the dynamic domain and this is the design's whole point (the A1 repair), with three honest qualifications carried through the merge. (1) The invariant is computed in SPACE-TIME — passing front-vs-behind a MOVING predicted world-tube — non-trivial exactly where the repo's current static H-signature (plan_minco.hpp passing_side, use_topology) is blind. (2) Rigor of the word: for a SINGLE ego vs N NON-reactive pedestrians the object is the WINDING / passing-side vector (a relative-homotopy invariant), NOT a full Artin braid element; 'braid' is branding from the SKEIN/TANGLE seeds — the provable claim is winding-vector completeness and must be stated that way. (3) Decisive framing (TRIAGE): per-episode SAFETY does NOT depend on winding-enumeration completeness — the continuous-time risk certificate is evaluated post-hoc on the chosen quintic path against the conformal tubes, so A1 (static completeness fails in dynamic domains) attacks ONLY the winding search's liveness/optimality, never safety. Output is always either ρ≤ε certified-safe or a certified max-clearance yield reporting ρ. Conditional on the main line's named assumptions: against PREDICTED conformal tubes (prediction error absorbed into r_i ⇒ a class collision-free vs the inflated tube is safe w.p.≥1−α_i), within commit horizon < tau_trust=0.75s, under pedestrian v_max + non-reactive (reactive agents switch class mid-episode → absorbed by per-round replanning; no mission-level claim). 3-D subtlety that strengthens coherence: around a 1-D pedestrian world-line in full 3-D homotopy is trivial (go over the top), so the winding lattice is the horizontal (x,y)+t projection with pedestrians as extruded cylinders; the genuinely-3-D over-the-top class IS the recovery/z-climb class, so it anchors totality rather than being an afterthought.
provable_claims: TOTALITY (never-⊥): for any (state, predicted tubes, budget ε, deadline>0) STRIDE terminates in ≤T_budget+O(M) and returns (τ, ρ∈[0,1]), never ⊥, because the recovery candidate set contains 'stay' (non-empty); committed prefix τ|[0,replan_dt] collision-free if a controlled-invariant safe action exists. SUB-LEMMA TO DISCHARGE: the spec-§3 z-climb-to-hover backup reaches a controlled-invariant safe set — NOTE recovery.hpp yield is currently HORIZONTAL-only (z=0 at line 28), so this is a coded TODO, not yet proven.

CONTINUOUS-TIME RISK SOUNDNESS (closes B5): if STRIDE returns winding β with {α_i}, Σα_i≤ε_pred, and every quintic segment's Bernstein coefficients of (r_i(t)+r_body)²−‖τ(t)−x̂_i(t)‖² are ≤0 (convex-hull lower bound, reusing minjerk_traj C2B_matrix/control_points — ALREADY golden), then min-over-t clearance≥0 continuously (not sampled) and P(collide with i over episode)≤α_i(+ε_cls share); union over H agents ⇒ P(any)≤ε_cls+ε_pred=ε.

ROUTER SOUNDNESS (O(M), one-sided): the INDEPENDENT Bunch-Kaufman/LDLᵀ inertia of the reduced (q,T) Hessian = (Sylvester) inertia of ∇²F; n_-≥1 ⇒ not a local min and the negative-curvature eigenvector is a strict descent direction (numerical-stall detection SOUND); n_-=n_0=0 ∧ ρ>ε ⇒ an unsafe strict local min ⇒ flip winding (the flip-helps converse is heuristic — state only the sound direction). MUST use a SEPARATE symmetric factorization: M(T) is asymmetric (solve_adjoint uses its transpose LU, minjerk_traj.hpp:261-265) so its LU CANNOT be reused for inertia.

RISK-BUDGET PARETO MONOTONICITY: fixing winding β, α(Σα_i≤ε)↦min-time feasible τ under tube radii r_i(α_i) is monotone (larger α_i ⇒ smaller tube ⇒ larger feasible set ⇒ min-time non-increasing); one λ-sweep traces a piecewise-monotone (time,risk) frontier whose breakpoints are active-set/winding switches.

DYNAMIC-DOMAIN WINDING-COMPLETENESS (conditional, weak): within tau_trust against the predicted tubes, the price-driven enumeration is complete over the FINITE set of realizable winding classes on the (heat-A* sides × ST-graph pass-order) lattice — if a tube-collision-free class exists it is found, else none is certified and the min-risk class returned. Conditional on lattice resolution + winding-vector (not full-braid) formalization; over winding classes, NOT all continuous free space.

ANYTIME GAP VALIDITY (DEMOTED — the weakest link): weak duality d(λ)≤r*(τ) gives a lower bound RELATIVE TO the enumerated winding lattice, so [R_incumbent−R_lb]≥0 is valid at every deadline; but TIGHTNESS is not provable and under the time-anchor objective the LB degrades to ≈0 (length-type, repo-confirmed) → this is anytime BEST-FIRST ordering, not a global-optimality gap. Do NOT over-claim (this is the M7 failure mode + the D1 seam).

consolidated.name: FULCRUM — Inertia-routed certified-escape MINCO (conservative no-braid hedge)
consolidated.one_liner: A MINCO-internal alternative that DECLINES the braid bet: an O(M) matrix-free second-order inner solve (reduced-Hessian Hvp reusing the already-paid banded LU) whose INDEPENDENT LDLᵀ inertia is read online to classify WHY the solve stalled {numerical / saddle / topological-trap / dynamically-infeasible} and route the matching escape, with FLECHE (numerical-algebraic-geometry critical-point enumeration) as a CERTIFIED topological-infeasibility decision for the frozen cell, FI-MINCO (quintic-Bernstein HOCBF) as the continuous-time safety accept-gate, and a total-function fallback ladder so the planner never returns ⊥ and never executes a between-sample collision. Completeness/optimality honestly scoped to per-replan QUASI-STATIC cells (no dynamic-homotopy claim); safety certificate dynamic-sound; dynamics handled by receding-horizon replanning + ST-graph re-timing.
genuinely_new_residual: INERTIA-AS-ROUTER (the only lever both new AND rigorous — shared with STRIDE but here CENTRAL): reading the reduced-Hessian inertia (λ_min sign + active-Jacobian rank + continuous-time residual) as an ONLINE typed diagnosis of the stall mode that dispatches a structurally-different recovery. Distinct from IPOPT/SQP inertia CORRECTION (they add δI to force a descent step; FULCRUM READS the same spectrum to route to FLECHE / re-time / yield, not to regularize). No prior planner reads its own reduced-Hessian spectrum to decide WHY it is stuck.

STRUCTURAL IDENTITY (honest headline, scale-limited): the MINCO flat-elimination reduced Hessian admits an O(M) matrix-free Hessian-vector product by REUSING the single banded LU of the ASYMMETRIC M(T) (forward + existing solve_adjoint transpose-solve) + segment-local dM/dT, d²M/dT² — making solver-level second-order MINCO tractable where prior art is universally first-order L-BFGS on (q,T). Non-obvious because M(T)'s asymmetry FORBIDS reusing its LU for the symmetric inertia (needs independent Bunch-Kaufman). Honest: GGN + Pearlmutter Hvp + banded preconditioning are each classic; new = exploitation of THIS structure; AND the O(M) win materializes only at large M (irrelevant at deployment M≤12 where dense LDLᵀ is μs) — so this is the ENABLING ENGINE, not the deployment headline.

FLECHE as a CERTIFIED topological-infeasibility DECISION for the flat-elimination cell: complete real-root enumeration of the polynomial KKT system yields a genuine certificate 'this homotopy class has no feasible stationary point' — the rigorous trigger to ABANDON a cell instead of timing out. Homotopy-continuation itself is classic; new as an escape OPERATOR keyed by the inertia router.

TOTAL-FUNCTION composition with a per-tick continuous-time safety certificate where the fallback rung is SELECTED BY the same inertia/feasibility diagnosis — 'constructively never stuck' with a TYPED reason at every rung (not a generic anytime incumbent).

FI-MINCO (supporting, shared with STRIDE): per-segment quintic-Bernstein HOCBF forward-invariance certificate reusing the existing C2B/control_points machinery as BOTH the accept-gate AND the DYN_INFEASIBLE router input — closes B5, dynamic-sound, O(M).
collision_targets: D2: second-order vs iLQR/DDP and any 'Newton/Hessian MINCO' — confirm NO prior does solver-level second-order on the flat-eliminated (q,T) reduced problem; quantify decision dim 4M−3 (~45 at M=12) vs DDP (n_x+n_u)K lift.
IPOPT/SQP inertia-controlling factorizations (Wächter–Biegler) — the SHARPEST collision; distinguish inertia-as-ROUTER from inertia-as-REGULARIZER on the full KKT.

T-MPC++ (de Groot 2024, T-RO) — distinguish: T-MPC++ PRE-enumerates homotopy + runs parallel MPCs (topology is INPUT); FULCRUM runs ONE second-order solve and READS inertia to decide online whether trapped, enumerating (FLECHE) only on a certified trap.
EGO-Planner-v2 — D1 topo-search + parallel optimization collision.

Numerical-algebraic-geometry / homotopy-continuation in motion planning (Bertini/PHCpack-style critical-point / IK root enumeration) — FLECHE novelty check: is per-cell KKT critical-point enumeration as a topological-infeasibility certifier already published.
Bernstein/SOS continuous-time trajectory safety + HOCBF-on-polynomial-splines — distinguish FI-MINCO from generic Bernstein-CBF feasibility certificates.
arXiv 2511.18170 (conformal × space-time) — overlaps the FI-MINCO dynamic certificate; check the continuous-time conformal-tube collision certificate is not already there.
GCS family (ST-GCS 2503.00583 / GCS* 2407.08848 / INSATxGCS 2410.08909) — contrast: FULCRUM's optimality/completeness is LOCAL/quasi-static per cell, NOT a global GCS gap.
Trautman–Krause (freezing robot) — FULCRUM makes a safety + total-function claim but EXPLICITLY not a formal liveness claim.
consolidated.dynamic_soundness: Honest SPLIT, deliberately NOT a braid. SAFETY is dynamic-sound: FI-MINCO certifies the executed quintic segments against the ANALYTICALLY-predicted moving spheres continuously over [0,Th] — signed distance to a moving sphere along a polynomial segment is itself polynomial in τ once the prediction is fixed, so the Bernstein convex-hull bound (existing control_points) gives a between-sample-tight certificate; exactly the dynamic guarantee the main-line safety paper can consume. COMPLETENESS/OPTIMALITY is deliberately scoped to per-replan QUASI-STATIC cells: within one replan the prediction is frozen and the active set fixed, so the local KKT FLECHE enumerates is a STATIC polynomial system; M6's trap detection and FLECHE's 'no feasible critical point' are sound only for that frozen cell. FULCRUM EXPLICITLY DECLINES both the static-H-signature-in-a-dynamic-domain claim (the A1 trap) AND the braid generalization (STRIDE's bet) — instead it keeps each cell quasi-static via st_graph (WHEN) + spacetime_corridor (WHERE) and relies on receding-horizon replanning for dynamics. Net: 'safety certificate dynamic-sound; completeness/optimality airtight only per quasi-static replan' — the most defensible position, at the cost of a lower novelty ceiling and NO dynamic-completeness/liveness claim.
provable_claims: O(M) Hvp: given the single LU of M(T), one reduced-Hessian-vector product ∇²F·v costs O(M b²) time / O(M b) memory (b=11 bandwidth) with NO refactorization (2 triangular solves on the existing LU + segment-local dM/dT, d²M/dT²); k extremal eigenpairs cost O(kM) via Lanczos.

Inertia soundness (no false saddle): Bunch-Kaufman LDLᵀ inertia of the assembled reduced Hessian = (Sylvester) inertia of ∇²F; λ_min<0 ⟺ a negative-curvature direction strictly decreasing F exists ⇒ a SADDLE classification always yields a real escape step. MUST use an independent symmetric factorization — M(T) is asymmetric (solve_adjoint:261-265).

Router exhaustiveness (basis of totality): at any non-converged feasible iterate exactly one of {numerical / saddle / topo-trap / dyn-infeasible} holds; each maps to a defined action ⇒ no unhandled state.

FLECHE completeness (quasi-static): for fixed active set A and fixed T the flat-elimination KKT is polynomial in q of bounded total degree d(M,|A|); homotopy continuation returns all real solutions ⇒ 'no feasible stationary point' is a SOUND local-infeasibility certificate. Scope: per cell, frozen prediction.

FI-MINCO continuous-time soundness (dynamic): if every segment's HOCBF Bernstein coefficients are ≥0 after ≤r de Casteljau subdivisions, then h(x(t))≥0 ∀t∈[0,T_i] continuously INCLUDING against analytically-predicted moving spheres ⇒ provably zero between-sample violation; cost O(M r).

Total function with safety certificate: at any deadline the output carries a continuous-time clearance≥0 certificate w.r.t. the predicted hard set; ladder exhaustive + each rung individually certified ⇒ output map total and safety-certified.

D2 quantification (honest negative): inner dim 4M−3 (~45 at M=12, M(T) 6M=72) vs iLQR/DDP (n_x+n_u)K; per-Newton-step O(M b² k_Lanczos) vs DDP O(K n³); advantage rests on (q,T)-only differential-flat + banded, and is ASYMPTOTIC (materializes at large M; at M≤12 dense inertia is already μs).

consolidated.why_keep: The conservative POLE of the central architectural fork — it DECLINES the braid/dynamic-completeness bet that STRIDE stakes everything on, so it is the defensible retreat if Wave3 finds the winding layer fatally collides with T-MPC++/Mavrogiannis or Wave4 cannot tame A1 dynamic-completeness. It still delivers a dynamic-sound safety certificate (FI-MINCO), a total function, and a genuine solver-level contribution (inertia-routed certified escape + O(M) second-order), and its modules (PRYBAR Hvp, the inertia router, FI-MINCO, FLECHE) ARE the leaf/escape machinery STRIDE reuses — so building FULCRUM directly de-risks STRIDE. Its headline (O(M) second-order) is admitted scale-irrelevant at M≤12, so it ranks below STRIDE, but the inertia-router core is the single thing most likely to survive prior-art + proof.

top_pick: STRIDE — it is the only candidate that simultaneously sits on the highest-novelty axis the search found (global space-time-winding + conformal-risk-price) AND directly carries the main-line RA-L safety layer (its min-risk scalar IS the P(hit)≤ε certificate, so the side-paper planner becomes the exact carrier the main paper §3 wants). Lead with totality + continuous-time risk soundness + the A1-decoupled dynamic story; DEMOTE the optimality gap to anytime best-first; and build FULCRUM's inertia-router / FI-MINCO / PRYBAR modules first as STRIDE's de-risked leaf substrate (FULCRUM is both the hedge and the staged path to STRIDE).
reasoning:
The four candidates collapse onto exactly TWO architectural bets, so I merged 3→1 and kept 1; a third candidate would only blur the one decision Wave4 must stress-test.

BET A (GLOBAL): STRAID, TRIAGE, TARIFF are the same animal — a global space-time-winding ('braid') planner that prices a tradeable conformal risk budget, rewrites 'stuck' as min-risk, and anchors totality at a recovery class. TRIAGE is already the natural fusion (global lattice + central inertia router + A1-decoupling); TARIFF supplies the most principled SEARCH (single-λ RCSP continuation that emits the (time,risk) Pareto front natively, conformal-quantile-as-dual-resource); STRAID supplies the most honest FORMALIZATION (winding-vector not Artin braid, budget⟷topology coupled by one λ). Their differences (lazy-conflict-branch vs best-first-PQ vs λ-continuation) are implementation variants of one search; the merge (STRIDE) takes λ-continuation as primary and loses nothing, giving Wave4 ONE object to hammer.

BET B (MINCO-INTERNAL): FULCRUM is the ONLY candidate that DECLINES the braid bet, putting the center of gravity back inside the solver (O(M) second-order + inertia router + FLECHE), keeping cells quasi-static, leaning on receding-horizon for dynamics. A genuinely different ARCHITECTURE, not a variant — kept as the conservative hedge. The fork Wave4 must hammer: GLOBAL-and-dynamic-complete (high novelty, A1 risk, collides T-MPC++/Mavrogiannis/2511.18170/IRA) vs MINCO-internal-and-quasi-static (lower ceiling, more defensible, collides iLQR/DDP/IPOPT-inertia). Two poles, two candidates.

RANKING by novelty × dynamic-soundness × buildability:
- NOVELTY: STRIDE > FULCRUM. The search's own verdict is 'global planner layer = highest novelty'; the solver-level second-order is 'combination + structure insight, not a new primitive,' and FULCRUM itself admits its O(M) headline is scale-irrelevant at M≤12. STRIDE's conformal-quantile-as-tradeable-dual-resource welded to the main-line certificate, with the price doubling as topology selector, is the freshest single object.
- DYNAMIC-SOUNDNESS: both sound, differently. STRIDE is sound IN the dynamic domain (winding = space-time invariant) AND crucially decouples safety from enumeration completeness, so A1 attacks only liveness — higher-reward but carries the A1/T-MPC++ exposure. FULCRUM is sound by AVOIDING the dynamic-topology claim (safety cert dynamic-sound, completeness only per quasi-static cell) — lower-risk.
- BUILDABILITY: both HIGH on substrate (verified: banded M(T)+solve_adjoint asymmetry, quintic C2B/control_points B5 substrate ALREADY exists, st_graph/spacetime_corridor, anytime_feasible, recovery, DynTraj label-set ABI ALREADY DONE). STRIDE's new code is moderate (winding signature, risk-priced RCSP continuation, inertia router) + the real cost is main-line surgery (q_conformal scalar→per-agent vector, recovery z-climb). FULCRUM is slightly more self-contained EXCEPT FLECHE's heavy external numerical-algebraic-geometry dependency — its biggest buildability + prior-art risk.

SHARED WEAKEST LINK (demote everywhere): the anytime GLOBAL-optimality / continuum lower bound. Under the time-anchor objective the LB degrades to ≈0 (length-type, repo-confirmed) → the 'global gap certificate' is vacuous = the M7 failure and the D1 seam. All three global candidates admit it; STRIDE keeps it only as best-first ordering and leads instead with totality + continuous-time soundness + winding-completeness.
